text:
sam_recruiter: Quick one  candidate in Spain verbally accepted. Team requests Band 5 bump (comp exception) +  sign-on. Start target 2026-07-06. Candidate needs voluntary health coverage active immediately due to ongoing treatment. Can we expedite? cc @ani_peopleops

ani_peopleops: For ES hires, statutory items flow at payroll start; voluntary coverages usually need ~30 days. Comp exceptions > 12% need Comp Committee review. If you mark urgent and attach medical note we can request an emergency review. What sign-on payout timing do you want?

tom_hr: We can request benefits backdated in medical cases, carrier permitting. We still need signed consent from candidate to share medical justification. Also note payroll cutoff: submit docs by 2026-06-25 for July payroll.

marta_manager: Hiring manager here  confirms business need, replacing on-call lead. Prefer lump sign-on on first payroll. Will present to Comp Committee if helpful. Start date is soft if committee needs a week.

payroll-bot: Reminder: attach ID, social security number, bank details, signed offer and compsheet. Missing items will delay pay and benefits.

sam_recruiter: I'll file the exception now with urgent flag, attach consent and compsheet, request lump sign-on at first payroll, and tag @ani_peopleops. Will update once filed. :thumbsup:
